# M5-S2: imported const func evaluation with transitive dependencies under
# ordinary module mode and vendor mode (T-201, T-Sec6, R-U2).
# Anchor: Tony Hoare, Richard Feynman
#
# Consumer imports package A (example.com/vmod/a).
# A's exported const func calls transitive package B (example.com/vmod/b).
# Consumer does NOT import B in source or signature.
#
# Both ordinary module mode and vendor mode are exercised with equal
# computed values and a constant array bound.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# 1. Ordinary module mode: consumer imports A, A calls transitive B.
cd mod_consumer
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/want.txt
stdout '^val: 35 bound: 17 len: 17$'
cd ..

# 2. Dynamic vendor mode via 'logos mod vendor':
# Build vendor directory from module dependencies, then run with -mod=vendor.
cd mod_vendor_gen
logos mod vendor
exists vendor/modules.txt
exists vendor/example.com/vmod/a/a.lgo
exists vendor/example.com/vmod/b/b.lgo

logos run -mod=vendor .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
cd ..

# 3. Fixture-owned vendor directory:
# A self-contained module with pre-vendored dependencies and vendor/modules.txt.
cd vendored_fixture
# Explicit -mod=vendor mode
logos run -mod=vendor .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt

# Default vendor mode in Go 1.14+ (presence of vendor directory with go 1.14+ in go.mod)
logos run .
cmp stdout $WORK/want.txt
cd ..

-- vmod/go.mod --
module example.com/vmod

go 1.27

-- vmod/b/b.lgo --
package b

const Step = 10

const func Transform(x int) int {
	return x*2 + Step
}

const func Bound(x int) int {
	return x * 4
}

-- vmod/a/a.lgo --
package a

import "example.com/vmod/b"

const LocalBase = 5

// Calc calls transitive const func b.Transform.
const func Calc(x int) int {
	return b.Transform(x) + LocalBase
}

// Bound calls transitive const func b.Bound.
const func Bound(x int) int {
	return b.Bound(x) + 1
}

-- mod_consumer/go.mod --
module example.com/modconsumer

go 1.27

require example.com/vmod v0.0.0

replace example.com/vmod => ../vmod

-- mod_consumer/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/vmod/a"
)

// Force compile-time evaluation of imported const funcs.
const (
	ComputedVal = a.Calc(10) // 10*2 + 10 + 5 = 35
	ArrayBound  = a.Bound(4) // 4*4 + 1 = 17
)

// Constant array bound forces compile-time integer constant requirement.
type FixedTable [ArrayBound]byte

func main() {
	var tbl FixedTable
	fmt.Printf("val: %d bound: %d len: %d\n", ComputedVal, ArrayBound, len(tbl))
}

-- mod_vendor_gen/go.mod --
module example.com/modvendorgen

go 1.27

require example.com/vmod v0.0.0

replace example.com/vmod => ../vmod

-- mod_vendor_gen/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/vmod/a"
)

const (
	ComputedVal = a.Calc(10)
	ArrayBound  = a.Bound(4)
)

type FixedTable [ArrayBound]byte

func main() {
	var tbl FixedTable
	fmt.Printf("val: %d bound: %d len: %d\n", ComputedVal, ArrayBound, len(tbl))
}

-- vendored_fixture/go.mod --
module example.com/vendoredfixture

go 1.27

require example.com/vmod v0.0.0

-- vendored_fixture/vendor/modules.txt --
# example.com/vmod v0.0.0
## explicit; go 1.27
example.com/vmod/a
example.com/vmod/b

-- vendored_fixture/vendor/example.com/vmod/b/b.lgo --
package b

const Step = 10

const func Transform(x int) int {
	return x*2 + Step
}

const func Bound(x int) int {
	return x * 4
}

-- vendored_fixture/vendor/example.com/vmod/a/a.lgo --
package a

import "example.com/vmod/b"

const LocalBase = 5

const func Calc(x int) int {
	return b.Transform(x) + LocalBase
}

const func Bound(x int) int {
	return b.Bound(x) + 1
}

-- vendored_fixture/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/vmod/a"
)

const (
	ComputedVal = a.Calc(10)
	ArrayBound  = a.Bound(4)
)

type FixedTable [ArrayBound]byte

func main() {
	var tbl FixedTable
	fmt.Printf("val: %d bound: %d len: %d\n", ComputedVal, ArrayBound, len(tbl))
}
